dek: APNIC 62 will explore two essential foundations of a resilient Internet: Intelligent network automation and trusted cybersecurity collaboration. Keynotes from Amajit Gupta and Yukako Uchida offer complementary perspectives on how technology and human relationships will shape the Internet's future.
